propositions: Ticket directory creation before first event file write can be interrupted, leaving empty stray directories that fsck reports as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH
New staging module makes directory and first event file creation atomic by building them together in a dot-prefixed staging path then publishing with a single os.rename under the existing write lock
Staging convention uses dot-prefixed temporary paths invisible to fsck scanners without requiring scanner changes; swept on writer start for stale staging dirs owned by dead processes
Multiple write paths (single-event, batch, reconciler inbound, and bridge alert emission) all shared the mkdir-then-file window and are converted to use StagedEvent.promote for atomicity
Rollback paths remove staging trees and remove ticket directories created by failed transactions, respecting bug 043f boundary by never cleaning event-less ticket dirs that already exist
